metadata.value: As Pellet needs an OWL API version lower than 4 (while the others need a version higher than 4) we provide two `pom.xml` files. Depending on which reasoner you want to run, you have to use the correct one. Further, you have to uncomment the respective reasoners in the `getReasoners()` function of the java file `org.unima.nheist.App`.
